limitations: Labels are assistant visual review, not human ground truth.
Frames selected approximately every20seconds per recorded session; sampling is irregular and neighboring frames may repeat within a test block.
Split by program/time block because recorded sessions overlap; no random adjacent-frame train/test split.
One small training ad break; only two evaluation blocks, neither cartoons.
Baseline is same-frame fresh Samsung verdict or Sponsored hit, not actual blocker effectiveness or its persistent cover state.
No end-to-end onset latency or false blocks per viewing-hour can be inferred from sparse screenshot labels.
Experimental141-feature approximation; no author checkpoint, different image resolution/filter/quantization choices, ad-vs-program training rather than paper FMPI target.
Host timings do not establish TV runtime feasibility.
No control changes and no persistent trained model exported.

native_metadata_audit.interpretation: Stored reference/position metadata is not a replay of the ordered fresh onset-event sequence; null active state remains unknown.

selection_and_labeling.selection: First frame then >=20 seconds per recorded session; deterministic chronological order; no selection using Samsung verdicts
selection_and_labeling.labels: Assistant visual review of contact sheets; not human verified; unknowns excluded
selection_and_labeling.split: Industry/border-control block versus outdoor-program block; recorded session0 overlaps both, so not used as split key
selection_and_labeling.forward_test: Train49 earlier industry/border frames, test128 later outdoor frames
selection_and_labeling.reverse_test: Train128 outdoor frames, test49 earlier frames; cross-domain diagnostic, not online incremental learning

gate: Do not deploy: insufficient evidence and cross-program false positives.
